record.paper_title: Some open problems in the theory of almost periodic functions
record.context_brief: Compactness and polynomial approximation in APr
record.original_question: For the spaces APr(R, C) with 1<r<2, investigate their internal analytic structure, including compactness properties and whether their elements can be approximated by trigonometric polynomials, for example by approximation schemes of Féjer–Bochner type.

evidence.quote: e) Investigate properties of the spaces APr, r ∈ (1, 2), as compactness, approximation of their elements by trigonometric polynomials (for example, of Féjer–Bochner type).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathrm{Trig}(\mathbb{R},\mathbb{C})$ denote the algebra of complex trigonometric polynomials on $\mathbb{R}$, i.e. finite sums $P(t)=\sum_{k=1}^N c_k e^{i\lambda_k t}$ with $c_k\in\mathbb{C}$ and $\lambda_k\in\mathbb{R}$. For $1\le r<\infty$, define the Marcinkiewicz-type seminorm
$$\|f\|_{M^r} := \limsup_{T\to\infty}\Bigl(\frac{1}{2T}\int_{-T}^{T}|f(t)|^{r}\,dt\Bigr)^{1/r},$$
and let $AP^{r}(\mathbb{R},\mathbb{C})$ be the completion (modulo functions of zero $M^r$-seminorm) of $\mathrm{Trig}(\mathbb{R},\mathbb{C})$ with respect to $\|\cdot\|_{M^r}$. For the parameter range $1<r<2$, study the internal analytic structure of $AP^{r}(\mathbb{R},\mathbb{C})$. In particular:

(a) Characterize the (pre)compact subsets of $AP^{r}(\mathbb{R},\mathbb{C})$.

(b) Determine whether every $f\in AP^{r}(\mathbb{R},\mathbb{C})$ can be approximated in the $\|\cdot\|_{M^r}$-seminorm by trigonometric polynomials produced through a Bochner–Fejér type summation procedure applied to the Fourier–Bohr series of $f$, and identify the precise summation kernels for which such approximation is valid.
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not produce a definitive resolution of compactness characterizations or Bochner–Fejér-type approximation results for the spaces $AP^r$ with $1<r<2$. General Bochner–Fejér approximation is classical for the uniform space $AP(\mathbb{R},\mathbb{C})$, and there is literature on related Marcinkiewicz/Besicovitch-type spaces, but no source clearly settles the specific structural questions in the range $1<r<2$.

status_evidence.title: Almost-periodic function - Encyclopedia of Mathematics
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Bochner–Fejér approximation in the uniform space and various generalized AP spaces, without resolving the structure of AP^r for 1<r<2.
status_evidence.claim: Classical Bochner–Fejér approximation is established for uniform AP, with generalizations indicated for other classes.

status_evidence.title: Approximation of almost periodic functions by periodic ones
status_evidence.snippet: Treats approximation in classes of almost periodic functions but does not specifically resolve compactness/approximation in AP^r for 1<r<2.
status_evidence.claim: Related approximation results exist but the specific AP^r (1<r<2) questions are not addressed conclusively.
